h: Ronaldo scores his 982nd career goal in an Al Nassr win
p: Cristiano Ronaldo has reportedly added another goal to his career tally, reaching 982 as Al Nassr won in the Saudi Pro League. The forward continues to chase the 1,000-goal milestone.
more: He is closing in on 1,000 career goals.
Al Nassr stay in the title race.
Fans are counting down the remaining goals.
